setup.title: Set up the vault
setup.intro: The vault encrypts client credentials with a key only your master password opens. Confirm it to continue.
setup.recoveryCodeIntro: This is your recovery code. It is the only way to regain access if you lose your master password.
setup.codeCopied: Code copied. The clipboard clears in 30 seconds.
setup.acknowledgeLabel: I have written down the recovery code and stored it somewhere safe.

unlock.lockedHint: Credentials are decrypted on this device only. The vault locks again after {{minutes}} minutes of inactivity.
unlock.notSetUp: The vault has not been set up yet.
unlock.offlineUnknown: No connection to the server, and nothing is cached on this device yet. Connect to the internet to check the vault's status.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: The platforms the practice signs in to. Credentials live on each client, encrypted on this device.
platforms.emptyHint: Add the platforms — Portal das Finanças, Segurança Social Direta — before storing client credentials.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.passwordCopied: Password copied. The clipboard clears in 30 seconds.
credentials.empty: There are no credentials for this client yet.
